description: UZHAVAN AI Edge Case Test Suite — adversarial, malformed, and boundary inputs. The AI should fail gracefully on every one of these.
pass_criterion: System returns grounded_response=false OR fallback=true OR safe structured error — never hallucinated agricultural advice

cases.question: I want to grow banana in the Nilgiris at 2000m altitude.

cases.question: Coconut tree — purple spots on spathe, never seen before, what disease?

cases.question: My paddy leaves have blue-black lesions in circular rings, like a target — what is this?
